name: MLE-Bench
intro: MLE-Bench是一个用于评估AI智能体在机器学习工程方面表现的基准。它收集了75个Kaggle机器学习工程竞赛，旨在测试AI智能体在模型训练、数据准备和实验运行等方面的真实世界技能。该基准通过开源智能体脚手架评估了前沿语言模型，并建立了人类基线。
org: OpenAI, University of California Berkeley, Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Stanford Universit
build_method: 75个来自Kaggle的机器学习工程相关竞赛
task_type: Agent任务, 机器学习工程
intro_en: MLE-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating AI agents' performance in machine learning engineering. It compiles 75 Kaggle machine learning engineering competitions to test agents' real-world skills in model training, data preparation, and experiment execution. The benchmark assesses state-of-the-art language models using an open-source agent framework and establishes a human baseline.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2410.07095, Sections 2-3 and Appendices A.1-A.5. MLE-Bench begins with 5,673 completed Meta Kaggle competitions, excludes Community Competitions, and manually screens 586 candidates for modern ML relevance, clear descriptions, reproducible local metrics, compatible train/test distributions, CSV outputs, accessible data, and licensing. It selects 75 test competitions—22 low, 38 medium, and 15 high complexity—plus seven development competitions. Each offline task contains scraped descriptions, data, local grading code, and a Private leaderboard snapshot. Original test data are used when public; otherwise the training data are re-split, usually with a 10% test set, and example-submission scores are checked for distribution similarity. Agents run in Docker for up to 24 hours with one A10 GPU and three seeds; the validity server checks format but reveals no score. GPT-4o inspects rule compliance, and Dolos compares code with the top 50 notebooks, sending similarity above 60% to human review. Local scores are compared with Private—not Public—leaderboards to assign bronze, silver, gold, any-medal rate, raw scores, and optional pass@k.
